title: Independence declaration — UCOS-URAT-001
authority: NONE — DERIVED TRUTH. This file confers no authority and states no rule. It names which instrument UCOS-URAT-001's registers must be verified AGAINST, and where the reviewed templates for those registers live.
$why_this_adoption_is_the_test_of_the_fr: UCOS-UCTX-001 is the capability the framework was extracted FROM, so its passing proves
only that the extraction was faithful. This is the first capability the framework was not
written for, and nothing in 00-BOOK/tools/ufi.py mentions it.
WHAT IS DELIBERATELY ABSENT FROM `authorities`. 00-MASTER/UCOS-URAT-001/urat.json is NOT
listed, although it is the richest structured description of this capability in the
repository. It is the producer's own OUTPUT — the generated-artifact registry declares it
as one of the five artifacts urat_engine.py writes. Verifying the registers against it
would put the validator back inside the loop it exists to break: a uniformly wrong engine
writes a wrong urat.json and wrong registers that agree with it perfectly.
So the corpus is the ONE authored instrument, and it is smaller and poorer than the
generated one. That is the correct trade and it is the point of the exercise.
